_about: Source of the ingredient deck. Order here is the numbering on the cards (M1, M2, ...). collisions lists pairs of card names that do not go well together; build_print.py turns them into the small notes on the cards.

mechanics.example_en: Gather matching cards before the others do.
mechanics.example_es: Reunir cartas iguales antes que los demás.

mechanics.example_en: Keep going for more points, but lose everything if it goes wrong.
mechanics.example_es: Seguir por más puntos, pero perderlo todo si sale mal.
